STOS(SAGA TELECOM OPERATING SYSTEM)
UNIFIED SWTICH SOFTWARE FEATURES LIST
Version: V1.0
Release Date: 2024/9/30
Overview
STOS, launched by Saga Telecom, is a switch operating system, which is also an unified software
platform used by all Saga Telecom high speed switches
Its advanced modular flexible architecture offers good hardware decoupling capability.
Saga Telecom constantly iterates and releases an updated versions every quarter to fix bugs or
update features, ensuring better adaptation to an ever-changing network environment
Keywords
l Accumulating and iterating over a span of 10 years
l An unified Software Platform
l Being verified in the extensive commercial network environment
l The features are modularized, which allows for pruning, and the code can be easily ported for
the same reason
